page.layout: One page of text, single column, centred; faint marginal show-through on the right edge (ignored); no legible margin notes. Running head at top; page number at top left; a tabular block of "Primæ,tres." and "Nam uel / Vel / Vel est" columns inside the text; diagram-like list of Celer/tardus lines at the foot; catchword-like "4 Tardus" at lower right treated as a line of text.

main_text.head: Inæqualiter inæqualis.
main_text.l: Reciprocus deficiens: atque alij sine nomine plerique.
main_text.p: Si inæqualitas in pulsu uno fuerit, ex motus inæqualitate duæ primæ differentiæ:

l.i: Vna in vna arteria parte, sed non eodem tempore:

main_text.l: Motus est perpetuus, quanquam disparis velocitatis. | Vel est

page.notes: Show-through from the facing page at the right edge and faint marks in the margins were not transcribed. Layout of the Celer/Tardus list uses numerals 1, 2, 3 as printed (the third numeral is a brace-like mark, read as 3). The final line "4 Tardus" is set at right and may be a catchword or sub-entry; treated as text.
